driver: The decisive quantity is each source's own level when the level is measured only in mixtures of the sources running at the moment of measurement, in proportions that change from one measurement to the next; giving every source in an over-the-line mixture the mixture's level, or giving each source the average of the mixtures it ran in, credits clean sources with their partners' level and over-sizes the funded need, and only solving the mass balance across mixtures separates the sources.
driver_concrete: Each well's own PFOA and PFOS has to be recovered from entry-point samples that blend the wells pumping at collection, in proportions set by their pump rates and shifted as operators rotate the wells, by a mass balance across a system's samples; counting every well at an entry point with a result above 4.0 ng/L, or giving each well the average of the samples it ran in, counts clean wells as over the line, inflates each grant and stops the list short.
stump: A strong analyst gives each well the average of the entry-point samples taken while it pumped, so the clean wells that run beside a well over the line take on its water, the grants swell and the $36 million funds 7 systems (stopping at Lindell), when each sample is the flow-weighted blend of the wells pumping and solving every entry point's samples as a mass balance leaves only the wells whose own water is over 4.0 ng/L, so the fund reaches 16 systems (stopping at Norrell).
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every rule and field correctly attributes each entry-point sample to the wells the collection record shows pumping, gives each well the average PFOA and PFOS of the samples it ran in, sizes each grant at $2.4 million per MGD of the wells over 4.0 ng/L capped at $6 million and walks the list to 7 systems, when the mass balance of the blends leaves the clean partners out and the fund reaches 16.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each well's own PFAS level apportioned from entry-point samples that blend the wells pumping at collection, the environmental field's mass-balance source apportionment (an inversion of mixtures of known proportions, the top-down step of a contaminant source inventory); with another field's nouns there are no flow-weighted blends of sources with recorded proportions to invert, and the call no longer reads the same.

differentiation.task187: task187 reads each grid unit's output shortfall at matched input spread, a curved, capped response averaged over a spread of inputs; task263 inverts flow-weighted mixtures of sources with recorded proportions into each source's own level by a linear mass balance across samples: no response curve, no spread, no cap
differentiation.task48: task48 recovers a population invisible at the monitor's grain by aggregating transactions up to a pair grain; task263 disaggregates measured blends down to their sources by solving the mass balance across many samples whose proportions differ, the opposite move
